# Collision-induced absorption, cm^-1 amagat^-2, of the far-infrared bands of gas pairs,
# each value the mean of the HITRAN table over +-5 cm^-1 about its wavenumber; HITRAN
# gives cm^5 molecule^-2, times Loschmidt's number squared, 7.2187e38 (Karman et al. 2019,
# HITRAN CIA, hitran.org/cia; downloaded 2026-11-08). A mixture absorbs
# k(A-A) rho_A^2 + k(A-B) rho_A rho_B + k(B-B) rho_B^2, rho in amagat, no factor 2 on the
# cross term (HITRAN CIA readme). Outside a table's span the absorption is taken as none.
#
# pair A B | source
# T t_1 t_2 ... (K)
# nu k(t_1) k(t_2) ... (cm^-1, cm^-1 amagat^-2)
